popup.title: Wavecrest
popup.description: One of two islands that made up the [[Eyes of Silvanus]] on the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]], protected by reefs and also the magic of the [[Emerald Enclave]].

popup.title: Ilighôn
popup.description: The island home of the [[Emerald Enclave]].

popup.title: Ixinos
popup.description: The island home to a matriarchal tribe comprised almost entirely of women and ruled by the [[amazon]] Queen.

popup.title: Alaor
popup.description: A pair of islands on the [[Alamber Sea]] that, for many years, was considered a tharch of [[Thay]] and served as a strategical naval stronghold for the magocratic nation.

popup.title: Ship of the Gods
popup.description: A volcanic island on the [[Alamber Sea]] and the cite of a secret temple to [[Geb]] called the [[Golden Forge]].

popup.title: Vathal
popup.description: A small island located on the [[Golden Water]] bay. It had no permanent settlements during the 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Mordyr
popup.description: A small island located on the [[Golden Water]] with no permanent settlements as of the 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Naarlith
popup.description: A small group of islands located in the Great Sea, roughly 120 miles (190 km) south of the [[Shining Lands]].

popup.title: White Rocks
popup.description: A single island in the [[Great Sea]], roughly 250 miles off the coast, south of the town of [[Zabbasz]].

popup.title: Isle of Quelthiir
popup.description: Or '''Passion Island''', was a 100-mile-long and 10-miles-wide large sandbar, with low hills and sea grass with only the occasional stunted tree.

popup.title: Talagath
popup.description: A small heavily forested island at the center of the strait known as [[Talagath's Gauntlet]].

popup.title: Stormwall
popup.description: The narrow islet that extended out from the sea at the edge of the harbor, shielding the bay of [[Tashluta]] from storms coming landward from the sea.

popup.title: Arnrock
popup.description: An active volcano and the largest island in the [[Lake of Steam]], once – home to a population of [[strongheart]] [[halfling]]s who collectively called themselves the [[Arn]].

popup.title: Felmer's Keep
popup.description: An island of note in the [[Lake of Steam]].

popup.title: Olodel
popup.description: An island, once a private hunting preserve for some eccentric, self-made [[Calishite]] merchants.

popup.title: Narruth
popup.description: The southwestern island sister of [[Olodel]].

popup.title: Nykkar, the Isle of Memory
popup.description: An island off the southern shores of Calimshan that was the central burial site of the nation's rulers and some of its nobility.

popup.title: Singing Rocks
popup.description: A collection of small islands off the coast of [[Calimshan]].

popup.title: Iyritrastrul
popup.description: The southern island of the duo known as [[the Tusks]], used as a stop to repair ships due to its abundant [[shadowtop]]s, [[duskwood]]s, and [[blueleaf]] [[tree]]s.

popup.title: Borammur
popup.description: The bigger northern island of [[the Tusks]] that once was a site of a prosperous [[copper]] mine, abandoned by the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Isle of the Circle
popup.description: An island of note in the [[Korinn Archipelago]].

popup.title: Thelve
popup.description: The largest island located immediately west off the shores of [[Candlekeep]], covered in fissured granite, temperate woodlands, and thousands of seabirds.

popup.title: Arthoum
popup.description: The smallest of the islands west of the shores of the fortress library of [[Candlekeep]], known for its geyser-like blowholes that released clouds of steam and water mist during storms.

popup.title: Nairn's Tomb
popup.description: A small island honeycombed by ancient dwarven tunnels that descended deep into the [[Underdark]].

popup.title: Askalet
popup.description: The island named after [[Askalath]], the wizard who once occupied a ruined tower on the island with a long shaft that connected it to the [[Underdark]].

popup.title: Sklorn
popup.description: A shipwreck-littered pirate island, home to a species of dimwitted fat [[gray coaster]] seabirds.

popup.title: Unglur
popup.description: The middle of the three islands of the [[Crab Reach]] located west of Thelve, haunted by the dreaded [[Spirit of Unglur]].

popup.title: Raerest
popup.description: The westernmost island of the [[Crab Reach]] once dominated by pirates, later claimed by [[lizardfolk]] of its large unnamed swamp.

popup.title: Hunters' Isle
popup.description: A small forested island at the center of a small lake – [[Ongul's Water]]'s namesake, that drained into the [[Starwater River]].

popup.title: Storna
popup.description: An island in the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] not far from [[Telpir]], used as a monster-breeding ground by [[Endreth Molipher]] and three [[wizard]] business partners starting around [[1359 DR]].

popup.title: Whamite Isles
popup.description: A cluster of small islands in the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]], controlled by the [[Emerald Enclave]] after [[1370 DR]].

popup.title: Wayrock
popup.description: An island and an 11,000-ft. (3,400-m) mountain in the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]]. It held ruins, and a temple of [[Cyric]] the Mad God.

popup.title: Prespur
popup.description: A duo of islands with the [[Cormyer]]ean town of [[Palaggar]] located on the larger one and [[Sembian]] town of [[Uarhold]] on the smaller one – the [[Traitor's Isle]].

popup.title: Orlumbor
popup.description: A small rocky barren island and a city-state famed for its skilled, in-demand shipwrights.

popup.title: Tharsult
popup.description: An independent island nation in the [[Shining Sea]] that grew bigger in the century that followed the [[Spellplague]], only to return to its former state with the [[Second Sundering]].

popup.title: Sorcerer's Isle
popup.description: An island located on the [[Stojanow River]] with the river splitting around the island, with a large [[silver]] pyramid occupying most of the island.

popup.title: Dragonisle
popup.description: The largest island in the [[Pirate Isles]], populated by around 4,000 pirates and was geographically dominated by the [[Earthspur]].

popup.title: Ulgar's Isle
popup.description: Also known as '''Ulgar Isle''', home to the [[Chessenta]]n [[vampire]] [[Ulgar]] and his [[undead]] minions.

popup.title: Fang Rocks
popup.description: A dangerous reef formation situated near the halfway point in the waters between [[Kelthann]] and the [[Dragonisle]].

popup.title: Hawk's Isle
popup.description: A forest-covered island in the [[Pirate Isles]], inhabited by deformed victims of an old plague.

popup.title: Kelthann
popup.description: The island also known as the '''Gateway to Sembia''', a smuggling port inhabited by [[human]] and [[hin]] worshipers of [[Grumbar]].

popup.title: Mirg Isle
popup.description: An island and a pirate stronghold.

popup.title: Telfar
popup.description: A small island in the southern [[Pirate Isles]] with an excellent natural harbor that made it a popular resting point for pirates returning from the open sea.

popup.title: Sarr
popup.description: A tiny storm-battered island with. a ruined lighthouse.

popup.title: Sumbar
popup.description: An island near the center of the [[Pirate Isles]] along the northwest edge of [[the Bowl]] inhabited by the mysterious [[Oracle of Nasmen]].

popup.title: Lith
popup.description: An unsettled island inhabited by a brood of ravenous [[neogi]].

popup.title: Lurath
popup.description: A small island of roughly 20 square miles, populated by primitive but friendly [[elvish]] creatures and several types of dangerous [[dinosaur]]s.

popup.title: Ilthan
popup.description: A medium-sized storm-battered island with no major settlements but an old ruin in the center and a population of [[cyclopskin]].

popup.title: Alphar Isle
popup.description: A large island of several friendly harbors, populated by around 3,000 pirates.

popup.title: Bulta
popup.description: A small and mysterious island inhabited by a wide assortment of half-sized animals called the [[minimal]]s.

popup.title: Oresk
popup.description: A small island with several natural harbors and three pirate strongholds.

popup.title: Paldir
popup.description: A small island with a large mountain dominating its landscape, mostly inhabited by ex-pirates and fortune seekers.

popup.title: Tan
popup.description: A small volcanic island with a large smoking crater at its center, that rumbled occasionally.

popup.title: Sylkiir
popup.description: An island of note.

popup.title: Lone Rock
popup.description: A tiny island known for its [[juniper]] plants.

popup.title: Sauros Island
popup.description: The island at the center of the [[Glumpen Swamp]], the location of a ruined keep taken over by [[lizardfolk]] sometime before the mid-14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Isle of Moas
popup.description: A mysterious island in the [[Moonsea]].

popup.title: The Dawn Warrior
popup.description: A small and dangerous uncalled island of overgrown jungles that repelled numerous attempts to settle it since the 700s [[DR]].

popup.title: Umbarra
popup.description: An island of note.

popup.title: Mother-Of-Mists
popup.description: An island in the [[Trackless Sea]] lying some way south of [[Lantan]] and west of [[Chult]].

popup.title: Ssan
popup.description: Also called '''the Daughters''', a small archipelago near the [[Mother-Of-Mists]].

popup.title: Suj
popup.description: The southern companion of the island of [[Lantan]], a fairly hilly land with rocky pinnacles emerging from lush jungles.

popup.title: Lantan
popup.description: An island-nation in the [[Trackless Sea]], known for its advanced technology and the population's devout worship of [[Gond]].

popup.title: Orlil
popup.description: A small rocky island located off of the southeastern coast of [[Lantan]], another significantly smaller island off of Orlil's shores was home to a population of sentient [[wombat]]s and [[platypus]]es.

popup.title: The Icepeak
popup.description: An island that was mostly made up of a huge volcano.

popup.title: Altarn
popup.description: One of the [[Brokenshores]] islands.

popup.title: Brokenshores
popup.description: Also known as '''The Thousand Swords''', an archipelago off the shores of [[Altumbel]].

popup.title: Gundarlun Island
popup.description: A subarctic island lashed with long winter storms inhabited largely by [[Northmen]]; with [[Gundbarg]], the Gateway Port on the island's eastern shores.

popup.title: Purple Rocks
popup.description: A small archipelago of rocky outcroppings that sheltered its verdant valleys from the storms behind their sparse forested peaks.

popup.title: Whalebones
popup.description: A small archipelago named after the [[whale]] skeletons that could be found on the islands' beaches.

popup.title: Ioma
popup.description: One of the larger islands in the [[Nelanther Isles]] with only one town, appropriately called [[Ioma Town]].

popup.title: Skaug
popup.description: A small island in the [[Nelanther Isles]] with a single settlement also called [[Skaug (port)|Skaug]].

popup.title: Ruathym
popup.description: One of the larger islands north of the [[Moonshae Isles]] in the [[Trackless Sea]]; a rocky island with rugged coasts, narrow coves, green hills, forested purple mountains, and a few villages.

popup.title: Dennik
popup.description: One of the larger but relatively featureless ilands of the [[Korinn Archipelago]] with its central plateau was prime land for grazing herds of animals.

popup.title: Dragonshome
popup.description: An island of note.

popup.title: Nerth
popup.description: An island of note.

popup.title: The Whale's Flukes
popup.description: A tiny archipelago, west of [[Chult]]'s shores.

popup.title: Mintarn
popup.description: A popular and beautiful safe haven for those fleeing the authorities as well as neutral ground for conflicting parties to come to an accord; popular for its [[almond brandy]], [[lager]], and [[green wine]].

popup.title: Flamsterd
popup.description: A [[wizard]]-settled isle, named after the [[WAterdhavian]] mage named [[Flamsterd]].

popup.title: Carcathen
popup.description: A small western island in the [[Nelanther Isles]] with no noticeable ports, riddled with coastal caves.

popup.title: Pandira
popup.description: An island within the [[Korinn Archipelago]] with the settlement of note named [[Westhaven]] as its port.

popup.title: Tetris
popup.description: A small southernmost island in the [[Korinn Archipelago]] inhabited by [[ffolk]] [[human]]s.

popup.title: Island of Viledel
popup.description: A tiny and mostly abandoned island – the location of the [[Island of Viledel]] and warring groups of [[orc]]s.

popup.title: Jacaman
popup.description: A small elongated isle located south of [[Dennik]].

popup.title: Rabin's Reef
popup.description: A forested island that was a popular summer destination for wealthy families, especially those of [[Ventris]].

popup.title: Ventris
popup.description: A major island within the [[Korinn Archipelago]] inhabited by [[human]]s, [[dwarves]], [[halfling]]s, and [[elves]].

popup.title: Chawdik
popup.description: A poor island that was part of the [[Korinn Archipelago]] that housed the the largest [[gnome|gnomish]] community among all the archipelago islands.

popup.title: Highport
popup.description: An island within the [[Korinn Archipelago]] in the [[Moonshae Isles]].

popup.title: Caftenor
popup.description: An island populated by [[halfling]]s with its one major settlement being [[Caftenor (town)|Caftenor Town]].

popup.title: Barret's Quay
popup.description: A small island in the eastern part of the Korinn Archipelago within the Moonshae Isles. Lacking any major port cities, it was mostly known for its reserved and secretive population of dwarves and humans.

popup.title: Finback
popup.description: The southernmost isle of the [[Whale Bones]].

popup.title: Skadaurak Island
popup.description: The volcanic island home to [[Hoondarrh]], an ancient and powerful [[red dragon]].

popup.title: Graygruun
popup.description: An island within the kingdom of [[Norheim]] in the [[Moonshae Isles]].

popup.title: Llorgh
popup.description: A large island within the kingdom of [[Norheim]].

popup.title: Irphong
popup.description: An island that was only used as a marker to show the northern end of [[Asavir’s Channel]] with It's only notable feature being one of the [[Sea Towers]].

popup.title: Nemessor
popup.description: A small island located in the [[Nelanther Isles]] that housed only one settlement –  [[Black Skull Cove]].

popup.title: Canthrell
popup.description: An island of note.

popup.title: Giantspine
popup.description: The largest island within the kingdom of [[Norheim]] in the [[Moonshae Isles]].

popup.title: Oman's Isle
popup.description: A n island that was a part of the kingdom of [[Oman]].

popup.title: Toaridge-at-the-Sun's-Setting
popup.description: The island that played an important role in the history of a powerful magic sword known as ''[[Taragarth]]''.

popup.title: The Rookery
popup.description: Also known as '''Pelath's Isle''', a low island had a thin grove of trees, a stone cottage with a garden, and numerous large rooks, inhabited by an old hermit [[mage]], [[Pelath]].

popup.title: Hook Isle
popup.description: A hook-shaped island, part of the [[Nelanther Isles]]; the [[Bay of Skulls]] near the center of the island gave it its noticeable crescent shape.

popup.title: Thordentor
popup.description: One of the largest islands by landmass in the [[Nelanther Isles]], it scared most pirates in the area off as each year, anywhere from 5–30 [[whale]]s beached themselves and died on its eastern and southern shores. Underneath the island stood a major stronghold of the [[Twisted Rune]].

popup.title: Amarune
popup.description: A small island found directly off the east coast of the kingdom of [[Gnarhelm]], just 5 miles (8 kilometers) off shore.

popup.title: Alaron
popup.description: The largest and most populous island in the [[Moonshae Isles]].

popup.title: Island of Solstice
popup.description: The snowflake-shaped island where [[Grimskalle]], a frost giant fortress, stood way north in the [[Sea of Moving Ice]].

popup.title: Norland
popup.description: An island in the [[Moonshae Isles]] that was inhabited primarily by [[Northlander]] [[human]]s.

popup.title: Moray
popup.description: The westernmost territory of the [[Ffolk]] and the wildest of the southern [[Moonshae Isles]].

popup.title: Gwynneth
popup.description: Also known as '''Sarifal''', the largest of the southern islands.

popup.title: Forgotten Island
popup.description: A small uninhabited island in the [[Shining Sea]], far to the south of [[Calimshan]] and off the coast of [[Chult]] – the hiding place of the [[Sunite]] relic called ''[[The Sacred Heart of the Beast]]''.{{approx}}

popup.title: Tuern
popup.description: An island in the [[Frozenfar]] in the [[Trackless Sea]].

popup.title: Island of Coral
popup.description: The island home of the [[reef giant]] [[Coral (reef giant)|Coral]].

popup.title: Snowdown
popup.description: One of the most temperate islands of the [[Moonshaes]], characterized by rolling hills and good roads.

popup.title: Umukek
popup.description: The northernmost named but uninhabited island in [[Faerûn]].

popup.title: Ghevden
popup.description: A large island of note in [[the Thousand Swords]].

popup.title: Sunset Isle
popup.description: An island of note west of [[Moray]].
